```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# TO MAKE A REPORT FOR ANOTHER SCENARIO
#   Copy this file to sim/analysis/outputs/<scenario>.qmd and change
#   params: scenario in the YAML header. Set params: p when the scenario was run
#   at more than one p. Everything below reads from the parsed tables, so no
#   other edit is needed.
#
# TO CHANGE WHICH MODELS ARE SHOWN, OR THEIR NAMES AND COLOURS
#   Edit default_models() in sim/analysis/R/models.r for a permanent change, or
#   the `models` line below for this report only.

# `params` only exists during quarto render. This fallback lets the chunks run
# one at a time in Positron; keep it in step with the YAML header.
if (!exists("params")) params <- list(scenario = "equalblocks.01", p = NULL)

# Find the repo root whether rendered (cwd = this folder) or run interactively
# (cwd = repo root), then load the analysis modules. bhCRR itself is not loaded.
root <- local({
  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "sim", "analysis", "R", "load_analysis.r"))) {
    if (dirname(d) == d) stop("Cannot find sim/analysis/R/load_analysis.r above ", getwd())
    d <- dirname(d)
  }
  d
})
source(file.path(root, "sim", "analysis", "R", "load_analysis.r"))
load_analysis(root)

res <- read_scenario_results(params$scenario, root, p = params$p)

# The model registry. To drop or reorder models for this report only, e.g.
#   models <- select_models(default_models(), c("bhcrr", "fg_oracle", "lasso"))
models <- resolve_models(default_models(), res$performance$Model)

kbl <- function(x, ...) knitr::kable(x, row.names = FALSE, ...)
```

# Scenario

`r scenario_design_notes(res) %||% "No DESIGN section found in the scenario file header."`

```{r}
#| label: tbl-overview
#| tbl-cap: "Data generating settings"
kbl(scenario_overview(res))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-blocks
#| tbl-cap: "Correlation blocks. Predictors are split into blocks with a common within-block correlation; the active predictors are spread across the blocks."
kbl(block_design_table(res), digits = 2)
```

## Simulation run

```{r}
#| label: tbl-provenance
#| tbl-cap: "Provenance of the parsed results"
prov <- run_provenance(res, root)
kbl(prov$summary)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-commits
#| tbl-cap: "Commits that touched this scenario's parsed results"
if (is.null(prov$commits)) {
  cat("Git history not available here.")
} else {
  kbl(prov$commits)
}
```

## Models compared

```{r}
#| label: tbl-models
kbl(models[, c("label", "model", "role")],
    col.names = c("Label", "Id in results", "Role"))
```

## Run health

```{r}
#| label: tbl-health
#| tbl-cap: "Runs per model. Usable = converged and returned coefficients; only usable runs enter the bias and selection summaries. Fit time includes shared comparator setup."
health <- run_health(res, models)
kbl(health)
```

```{r}
#| label: health-flags
#| results: asis
bad <- health[health$Usable < health$Runs, ]
if (nrow(bad)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-warning}\n## Failed fits\n\n")
  cat(sprintf("- **%s**: %d of %d runs usable.%s\n", bad$Model, bad$Usable,
              bad$Runs, ifelse(bad$Usable == 0,
                               " It is absent from every plot and table below.",
                               "")), sep = "")
  cat(":::\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-tuning
#| tbl-cap: "Tuning diagnostics for models that report them"
tune <- tuning_summary(res, models)
if (!is.null(tune)) kbl(tune)
```

# Coefficient bias

The bias summaries cover the `r sum(res$design$beta1_active != 0)` active predictors only. Panels are the correlation blocks, ordered by within-block correlation.

```{r}
#| label: bias-summary
bias_sum <- summarise_bias(res$betas, models, active_only = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-estimates
#| fig-cap: "Mean estimate by predictor against the true coefficient."
plot_estimates(bias_sum)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-bias
#| fig-cap: "Mean bias by predictor."
plot_bias(bias_sum)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-pct-bias
#| fig-cap: "Mean percent bias by predictor. Negative values are shrinkage toward zero for either sign of the truth; the dotted line at -100% is an estimate of exactly zero."
plot_pct_bias(bias_sum)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-bias-block
#| tbl-cap: "Bias over the active predictors, by block"
kbl(bias_by_block(res$betas, models), digits = 3)
```

# Variable selection

A predictor counts as selected when its estimated coefficient is nonzero. Truth is a nonzero cause 1 coefficient.

```{r}
#| label: selection
sel <- selection_metrics(res$performance, models)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-confusion
#| fig-height: 3.2
#| fig-cap: "Mean confusion matrix per model."
plot_confusion(sel)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-selection
#| tbl-cap: "Selection and prediction metrics, mean (SD) over usable runs"
kbl(summarise_selection(sel))
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-selection
#| fig-height: 6.5
#| fig-cap: "Distribution over runs of the selection metrics and the Wolbers C-index."
plot_selection(sel)
```

## By correlation block

```{r}
#| label: fig-selection-block
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-cap: "Recall among the active predictors and false positive rate among the null predictors, by block."
sbb <- selection_by_block(res$by_block, res$performance, models)
plot_selection_by_block(sbb)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-selection-block
#| tbl-cap: "Selection by block. FP rate pools counts over runs."
kbl(summarise_selection_by_block(sbb), digits = 3)
```
